name: Film grain overlay
summary: Subtle full-frame film grain with occasional scratches, re-seeded every two frames; for a filmic, vintage texture.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: seed
params.note: change for a different grain pattern

author: krakujs
